scope: Read-only integration/source review of bounded staged capture, controller, root hook, durable scope validation and the two authorized review fixes.

findings.closure: Both deferred error paths cancel only if the captured A state still owns the collector. Replacement B retains its timer, chunks and output; the SDK/digest regressions exercise both paths.

The private bridge scope starts before initial authorization, propagates the original start to the adapter and stays guarded through final authorization/publication. Timeout and cleanup are scope-owned: expired A checks captureScope===A before clearing the handle; releaseCapture(A) never clears the B pointer; replacement/Clear/load/cancel abort and release their actual scopes.
